name: dsh-report-mode
description: Report mode for DSH: FineReport/.cpt delivery preset (MCP capabilities are mounted by the owning profile; persona does not embed MCP tool usage). Report artifacts and sandbox* historical data stay in the local repository only: the preset vendors a local-only git workflow (init/status/diff/log/commit/branch; no push, no remote creation). Delivered as a DSH 0.2.0 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-preset` declaration row.

scripts.test: node scripts/scan-secrets.mjs && node scripts/sync-preset.mjs --check && node --test test/host-guards.test.mjs test/persona-alignment.test.mjs test/local-git.test.mjs
scripts.gate: node scripts/scan-secrets.mjs && node scripts/sync-preset.mjs --check && node --test test/host-guards.test.mjs test/persona-alignment.test.mjs test/local-git.test.mjs
